text:
Noelle (product): FYI — competitor launched a low-cost retrieval bundle. getting price-push from three pilots. need a tiny ops play to keep deals without shipping a full quantized runtime.
Arjun (PM): propose a 2-lane plan: FAST shuttle (proxy routing + sampling) and SLOW defend (quantized local tier). FAST should be demoable in ~1 week.
Tess (eng): confirm FAST = proxy + param-transforms + live-compare sampling. low-risk but watch streaming compatibility. estimate 2 engs, 5 working days. SLOW = 6-8 weeks (quantize, infra, perf tests).
Vik (sales): pilots will sign if we can show a reproducible ~50% unit-cost reduction and clear opt-out. legal will require data-routing disclosure.
Marta (solutions): FAST config example (yaml):
```
route_policy:
  - id: low_cost_fallback
    when: tenant_flag.enabled
    actions:
      - forward: partner.endpoint/serve
      - transform:
          embed_precision: 8bit
          truncate: 1024
    sampling: 20%
```
Marta (solutions): suggest sampling so we can A/B quality without full migration.
Leo (data): KPIs to instrument: per-tenant cost per 1k tokens, delta in rerank relevance (NDCG@10), p95 latency overhead. baseline cost = $0.0071/token; pilot goal = <=$0.0035/token. add alert if NDCG drop >18% or error rate >0.8%.
Hannah (design): Console UX: small "Cost mode" pill with inline modal: "Low-cost mode routes some requests externally and may affect relevance. Toggle per-route." simple mock attached.
Arjun (PM): Launch gates for FAST: deliver proxy + console toggle + dashboards; gate to continue: two pilot tenants hit >=40% cost reduction and avg NDCG drop <=15% on their eval sets over 10k queries, and no SLA tickets in 2 weeks.
Tess (eng): streaming caveat: if partner doesn't support chunked streaming we must preserve semantics by proxying and buffering — adds latency. will include fallback to local model if latency >1s.
Vik (sales): I'll get commitments from Polar & Nexo for pilots. will include opt-in language and expected beta pricing.
Marta (solutions): for tenants with data restrictions we must flag them as "no-external-routing"; those go to the SLOW lane.
Leo (data): I'll wire dashboards: per-tenant cost, NDCG delta, latency p95, error rate. ETA 3 days.
Noelle (product): owners: Tess -> proxy PRD + canary (due Fri), Marta -> transform spec & legal checklist (due Thu), Leo -> dashboards (Wed), Hannah -> modal copy + mock (Wed), Vik -> pilot signups (EOW).
infra-bot: canary job queued for branch `price-shuttle-proxy` at 04:10 UTC :rocket:
Arjun (PM): if FAST meets gates we convert to paid beta and schedule quantization work as follow-up. if not, deprecate FAST and accelerate SLOW.
Noelle (product): Action: everyone update this thread with blockers. keep pilot comms transparent about tradeoffs. thanks :thumbsup:
